entry: Same 990 monthly long single-option trades. Initial stock hedge at first eligible observation after entry, independently of periodic schedule; the entry day counts as the daily schedule's first hedge day.
exit: Keep original option entry and planned exit. Retain research capital reserve; flag changed exits. Always close any remaining stock hedge when the option closes, regardless of scheduled hedge time.
elapsed_hours: Elapsed calendar minutes including nights and weekends, but orders only at eligible NYSE regular-session observations. Consequently 12 calendar hours normally produces one adjustment near the next open, not an overnight hedge.
trading_hours: Accumulate actual within-session time intervals only, excluding overnight and holidays and honoring early exchange closes. Invalid or missing intraday observations do not stop the trading clock; they prevent execution until a later eligible observation.
daily: After initial hedge, at most one scheduled attempt per subsequent exchange day, first eligible observation at/after 10:00 New York or official session close minus 15 minutes. No adjustment later that day if a scheduled target required zero shares.
costs: Unchanged observed bid/ask, stock/option fees, stock sell surcharge, 1bp extra stock slippage, SOFR spreads, stock borrow and idle-cash benchmark. Zero-execution-cost books use identical actual orders and exits and retain financing, borrow and abandoned-rights writeoffs.
comparison: Reproduce all original hourly cash results with the schedule fork before comparing added frequencies. Report full cohort and stock/year/tenor splits; no threshold or instrument reselection, no portfolio netting, no new data purchases. Day and hour schedules were specified before new P&L.
